map.从质量、价格、交期、服务四维度加权评分，自动排名选出最优供应商: Weighted scoring across four dimensions — quality, price, delivery, service — with automatic ranking to select the best supplier
map.综合评分 = 质量×交期×价格×服务: Composite score = quality × delivery × price × service
map.年度供应商绩效排名：录入口径统一的四项评分（质量/价格/交期/服务），设权重自动: Annual supplier performance ranking: enter four uniformly-calibrated scores (quality/price/delivery/service), set weights for automatic ranking and grading.
map.寻源选型：对新引入的若干候选供应商打分，按综合分选出最优，作为定点依据。: Sourcing selection: score several newly introduced candidate suppliers and select the best by composite score as the basis for sourcing.
map.KPI 考核：将季度考评的四维得分代入，跟踪各供应商排名变化与短板维度。: KPI appraisal: substitute the quarterly four-dimension scores to track each supplier's ranking changes and weak dimensions.
map.权重合计不是 100% 会怎样？: What if the weights do not sum to 100%?
map.工具会自动归一化：实际权重 = 你填的权重 / 四项之和，因此无需手动凑 100: The tool auto-normalizes: actual weight = your weight / sum of four, so you need not manually reach 100%. The page shows 'weight total' and hints whether it equals 100% for easy checking; even if not fully filled it scales proportionally (defaults to equal weight when all are 0).
map.四个维度评分怎么来？: How do the four dimension scores come from?
map.质量/价格/交期/服务各为 0–100 的归一化得分，可由企业考评细则映射（如合: Quality/price/delivery/service are each normalized scores of 0-100, mappable from enterprise appraisal rules (e.g. pass rate → quality score, quote competitiveness → price score, on-time rate → delivery score, response and after-sales → service score). Always use scores of the same scale, so cross-dimension comparison is meaningful.
